Latch caller cancellation and serialize it with final outbound admission. Calls cancelled while waiting for SDK_LOCK send zero requests and finish as ERROR/CANCELLED with NOT_SENT; admitted workers retain their lock and finish their original audit.

Validate choice count/index, role, refusal, tool calls, status, finish reason and text before projecting a provider success. Persist envelope_validated and require it for recovery; missing validation facts never authorize restoration or re-dispatch.

Share generation validation between saved profiles and requests. Support presence_penalty, frequency_penalty and reasoning_effort alongside retained safe options; reject unknown parameters and invalid values before persistence. Replace fictional unsupported extension fixtures with supported options.
Explain RULE_TOKEN_CHANGED, CANCELLED, AUDIT_STORAGE_ERROR, AUDIT_FINISH_FAILED and OPERATION_BLOCKED; extend frontend assertions and account for the added read-only Prompt section.

Inject the applied runtime configuration into schedule/status. Report installed scan availability, including deployment overrides and apply failure; standalone projections share the same typed precedence. Verify both override directions, API apply failures and UI override display.
